capture_policy.hash_scope: SHA-256 of exact content-decoded HTTP response-body bytes fetched with curl --fail --location --compressed. Raw bodies remain temporary. Exact retrieval time was not retained unless the response itself supplies a server timestamp.
capture_policy.rights_scope: Compact factual paraphrases and provenance only; no publisher media or full source bodies are redistributed. The Espoo open-data landing page links CC BY 4.0; other source-specific reuse permissions are not inferred.
capture_policy.review_scope: No core or generated dataset acceptance is made here. An address/permit/parcel source is a locator and identity source, not a recent physical-status observation. Geographic match scores are not horizontal accuracy.
capture_policy.projection_method: pyproj 3.7.2 with PROJ 9.5.1, Transformer.from_crs(source_epsg, 4326, always_xy=True). No coordinate is inferred from a city centroid or frozen rough point.
capture_policy.pdf_review: Read PDF skill and visually inspected rendered Goodman pages 13, 14, 15 and 44 and Kirkkonummi page 1; facts below follow visible tables and labels, not noisy third-party OCR.
